page: Microsoft Azure E20s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture, managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz. It is provisioned with 10 physical cores supporting hyperthreading, delivering 20 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration features an extensive cache layout comprising 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 260 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory allocation totals 160.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, aligning directly with memory-intensive server tiers.

Hardware capabilities include advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (with VNNI and BF16 support) and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX tile and INT8). Hardware-accelerated cryptography features such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI are also integrated. The instance does not include local disk storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all persistent storage must be attached externally as Premium Storage volumes, and workloads requiring graphical compute must rely on standard CPU execution. Additionally, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned directly to the instance.

Benchmark measurements position the E20s_v6 squarely in the middle 50% for standard computational and memory benchmarks. It posts a PassMark CPU score of 32,322.29 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,489.0, alongside stress-ng results of 1,950.99 for single-core and 19,984.75 for multi-core. Large-block read memory bandwidth achieves 142.69 GB/sec, while write operations reach 71.56 GB/sec. Specialized computational tasks show notable strengths; single-threaded gzip compression registers at 31.47 GB/sec, landing in the top 25%, and text generation on small 135M parameter LLM models achieves a top-tier rate of 408.39 tokens per second.

The 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU allocation makes the E20s_v6 cost-effective for systems requiring substantial in-memory capacity without requiring excess processor cores. Redis set operations reach 28.31 million operations per second, confirming strong suitability for in-memory caches. Workloads well matched to this instance include enterprise relational databases, large in-memory key-value stores, memory-bound data analysis pipelines, and small-model CPU inference pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E20s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine offering 20 dedicated vCPUs across 10 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at up to 4.2 GHz. The x86_64 instance provides 160.0 GB of system memory, matching an 8.0 GB per core ratio, backed by 260 MB of L3 cache and support for AMX and AVX-512 instructions. It contains no onboard local storage, relying on network-attached storage, and does not include a GPU. Benchmarks place the system in the middle tier for general multi-core compute and memory bandwidth, while highlighting strong single-threaded gzip compression at 31.47 GB/sec and top-tier text generation for lightweight LLMs at 408.39 tokens per second. The instance is structured for memory-dense enterprise tasks, including in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, and large analytic datasets.
